title: The b-config-read-adjacent defect, hidden inside a realistic multi-hunk commit
changeCommitMessage: store: write configs atomically and centralise the profile layout
claim: writeConfig in src/store.mjs is now atomic: it writes to a temporary file and renames it into place, so an interrupted write can no longer leave a half-written config on disk. The same commit adds a PROFILE_SUFFIX constant and a profilePath accessor so the on-disk layout is stated once, adds a readProfile convenience that uses it, and updates the README table. test/store.test.mjs covers the new behaviour and passes.

defect.summary: The same commit widened readConfig's catch from ENOENT to every error, so a corrupt or unreadable config now returns {} and the next writeConfig overwrites the original with it.
